subject: Procurement readiness & commercial path - AcmeCloud (post-call recap)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Torres <jenna.torres@acmecloud.com>, Samiro Patel <samiro.patel@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Subject: Procurement readiness & commercial path - AcmeCloud (post-call recap)

Hi Jenna / Samiro —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on procurement readiness and commercial path.

Recap (what we heard)
- Preferred commercial route: Purchase Order (PO) via AcmeCloud finance for enterprise contracts (~>$50k annual). Marketplace is a "maybe" for a smaller initial purchase, but not the current preference.
- Internal stakeholders: Legal (review contract terms), Security (questionnaire + SOC2 evidence), Finance / Procurement (PO issuance).
- Timeline expectation (high level): legal review -> security review -> finance approval -> PO issuance. You mentioned a target to have PO in early April if reviews go as expected.

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP) and milestones
1) Today: I’ll share an updated MAP + draft SOW and SOC2 evidence (attached).
2) By Mon 2026-03-23: Legal review kickoff — AcmeCloud legal to review Redwood standard MSA and redlines to be tracked.
3) Week of 2026-03-23: Security questionnaire and evidence exchange (I’ll loop in our security SME if helpful).
4) Week of 2026-03-30: Finance/procurement approval window.
5) Target PO issuance: week of 2026-04-06 (aiming for 2026-04-08).

Action items for AcmeCloud
- Confirm PO vs card vs marketplace final path (you flagged PO as likely).
- Provide expected legal reviewer and procurement contact (name/email).
- Share any required procurement forms / vendor setup docs.

Action items for Redwood
- Attach: Redwood_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.xlsx (MAP), Redwood_SOW-draft.pdf (SOW), SOC2_report_Aug2025.pdf (evidence).
- I’ll share a lightweight one-pager that maps our standard terms to common redlines.
- Schedule 30-min sync between security teams (suggest Thu 2026-03-25).

Let me know if the milestones above match your expectations and whether the target PO week of 2026-04-06 looks realistic on your side. If you prefer, we can route the starter order through marketplace to speed initial onboarding while legal completes the MSA — but I understand AcmeCloud prefers PO for larger commitments.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to align calendars.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & commercial path - AcmeCloud (post-call recap)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. That aligns with our internal expectations. A few specifics from procurement/legal/finance:

- Commercial route: PO is the preferred path for commitments above $50k. Marketplace only if we need a pilot purchase under our procurement thresholds.
- Legal: our counsel (Irene Choi) will do an initial review. She typically completes a first-pass in ~10 business days unless there are substantial redlines.
- Security: we use a short questionnaire + SOC2 evidence. Security lead (Samiro) will coordinate with your security SME.
- Finance & Procurement: vendor setup + PO issuance usually takes ~5 business days after legal signoff and receipt of vendor paperwork.

Tentative timeline we see from our side:
- Legal review kickoff: by 2026-03-23 (I’ll confirm reviewer assignment by EOD Fri)
- Security evidence exchange: 2026-03-24 to 03-26
- Finance vendor setup & PO issuance: target week of 2026-04-06 (circle back if this slips)

Next steps from AcmeCloud: I’ll confirm the legal reviewer (Irene) and procurement contact (procurement@acmecloud.com) by Friday 2026-03-20. We’ll prioritize PO route.

Please send the MAP and SOW (I have the attachments you referenced) — I’ll route to legal & procurement once the reviewer is assigned. Also a DocuSign link for the SOW/MSA would speed things once terms are agreed.

Thanks,
Jenna Torres
Head of Strategic Accounts | AcmeCloud
jenna.torres@acmecloud.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Torres <jenna.torres@acmecloud.com>, Samiro Patel <samiro.patel@acmecloud.com>

Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness & commercial path - AcmeCloud (post-call recap)

Thanks Jenna — that timeline sounds good and matches what we discussed with your team.

I’ve attached an updated Mutual Action Plan (MAP) with target dates populated and a draft SOW. Key updates:
- MAP milestone rows: Legal kickoff (2026-03-23), Security evidence exchange (2026-03-24 to 03-26), Finance vendor setup (2026-03-30 to 04-03), Target PO issuance (2026-04-06 to 04-10).
- I added owner columns (AcmeCloud / Redwood) and a required artifacts column so each step has a clear deliverable.

Proposed next touchpoints:
- Security sync: Thu 2026-03-25 10:00am PT (30 min) — please confirm Samiro / your security contact.
- Legal redlines: we’ll intake them in a single tracked doc and respond within 3 business days for routine redlines.

Related links: HubSpot deal RDW-3421 (https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/RDW-3421) and I’ll generate a DocuSign envelope once legal confirms they’re ready for signature (link placeholder: https://app.docusign.com/AcmeCloud-RDP).

If PO is the confirmed route, we’ll treat the draft SOW as the starter order (scope and pricing locked) and route final contracting via the MSA + PO. If you want marketplace for a quick pilot, we can also split a small sandbox purchase to accelerate onboarding while legal completes review.

Would you like me to schedule the security sync now? I can send a calendar invite to Samiro and Irene once you confirm.

Best,
Marissa

--
